description: Building block to implement relations to other resources using a URL and some semantics.

Relation.description: DCAT Relationship surface added on top of the schema.org labeled link construct. This block is an allOf of labeledLink and this surface, so a "@type" with contains: dcat:Relationship here applied to EVERY cdifReference -- alongside labeledLink's contains: schema:CreativeWork -- making the two co-types mandatory and the block unsatisfiable for an ordinary labeled link. schema:license recommends exactly such a link ("recommend using schema:CreativeWork to provide a label (name) for the license"), and every example that followed that advice failed. The co-type mandate is therefore gone: @type is governed solely by labeledLink, which already requires schema:CreativeWork and permits dcat:Relationship alongside it. This matches rules.shacl, where cdifReferenceShape targets dcat:Relationship as a class -- the relation rules apply to nodes that declare it, rather than forcing every labeled link to.

dcat:hadRole.description: Role of the related resource as a SKOS Concept (DCAT canonical role slot).

dcterms:relation.description: URI of the related resource (DCAT canonical pointer to what is being related to; distinct from schema:url which is the presentation URL inherited from labeledLink).
